scope: Replay of preserved finite probes at pinned source commits. Historical source-path recovery is preserved separately and not rerun by this script.

nonconsequential_extension.standing: Authored expansion; the structural operation does not establish semantic novelty.

unimplemented_declared_transition.standing: Reachability in the supplied graph with fixed observation meanings. Conditions do not change along an edge; real execution and unknown operations are outside this result.

results.interpretation: These probes establish finite behavior and its semantic boundaries; they do not measure LLM self-improvement.
